resources.string: Each lecture is a sketchnote. Tap listen: the teacher explains the idea in Urdish for an intermediate student. She does not read the board.
Sketchnote دیکھو۔ آواز board نہیں پڑھتی، Urdish میں idea explain کرتی ہے۔
Open a chapter, then a lecture. The sketchnote explains the whole topic in Urdish.
Install Google Urdu TTS if the Urdish lecture voice does not start
No English note in this topic.
